proof_body:
by
  intro f hzero hpos
  have heq : Filter.EventuallyEq (nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0)) f (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) := by
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with x hx
    exact hpos x hx
  have hlim : Filter.Tendsto f (nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.congr' heq.symm
  refine ⟨hlim, ?_⟩
  intro hc
  have hone : Filter.Tendsto f (nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds 1) := by
    simpa [hzero] using hc.tendsto.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  have hfalse : (0 : ℝ) = 1 := tendsto_nhds_unique hlim hone
  norm_num at hfalse
target_source: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hzero : f 0 = 1) (hpos : ∀ x, 0 < x → f x = 0), Filter.Tendsto f (nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds 0) ∧ ¬ ContinuousAt f 0
